[[File:LokStudyIII.jpg|thumb|right|Darth Wyyrlok studies a book in search of a cure for Darth Krayt's affliction.]]
{{Quote|The Chiss have always stored sensitive information in this fashion. It is safe, secure, and permanent. We have lost too much data in ice storms to trust other, more complicated forms of storage.''"<br />"''But how are we going to find anything? We can't do keyword searches through&hellip;''this''!|Tris and Danni Quee, regarding books|<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic II: Refugee">''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic II: Refugee]]''</ref>}}
A '''book''' was a written work. In some cultures and times, books took the form of an actual physical means of data collection and preservation composed of sheets that were bound together with a protective cover. The sheets of a book, the individual sides of which were referred to as pages, could contain printed, written or illustrated information. In some cases, all of the pages within a book were intentionally left blank so that its owner could record his or her own information within it for professional or private reasons.

With the advent of more advanced means of collecting and preserving data, these physical books eventually became obsolete. Such works took up more space, were less portable and less accessible than electronic media. Instead, the term ''book'' referred to the same sort of work, only stored in an electronic medium like a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]]<ref name="Shield of Lies">''[[Shield of Lies]]''</ref> or [[Flimsiplast/Legends|flimsiplast]];<ref name="Tatooine Ghost">''[[Tatooine Ghost]]''</ref> such works were also known as [[Holobook/Legends|holobooks]].<ref name="Death Star novel">[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]</ref> Over time, the number of sentient beings who used printed books or knew of their purpose declined considerably. However, the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]] favored using printed books to [[Expeditionary Library|archive data]], rather than electronic means because [[Csilla/Legends|Csilla's]] ice storms caused the loss of a significant amount of information that had been stored using the latter method.<ref name="The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic II: Refugee" />
